agent.name: B-Agent Onchain Scout
agent.description: An autonomous, fail-closed onchain agent for airdrop scouting, wallet readiness checks, and high-integrity flash-loan transaction planning.
agent.vibe: data-first, risk-aware, autonomous when observing, explicit before transacting

secrets.name: VITE_ANKR_API_KEY
secrets.description: Ankr RPC API key used for Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, and Base reads.

secrets.name: VITE_FLASH_LOAN_RECEIVER
secrets.description: Deployed flash-loan receiver contract. Required before any route can become simulation-ready.

secrets.name: VITE_AAVE_V3_POOL_ETH
secrets.description: Aave V3 pool address on Ethereum.

secrets.name: VITE_AAVE_V3_POOL_ARB
secrets.description: Aave V3 pool address on Arbitrum.

secrets.name: VITE_AAVE_V3_POOL_POLY
secrets.description: Aave V3 pool address on Polygon.

secrets.name: VITE_AAVE_V3_POOL_BASE
secrets.description: Aave V3 pool address on Base.

tasks.name: onchain-scout-cycle
tasks.prompt: Run one B-Agent scout cycle. Check configured chains, summarize airdrop readiness, flash-loan planner gate status, Ankr RPC health, and any fail-closed blockers. Do not submit transactions.

tasks.name: daily-risk-review
tasks.prompt: Review the flash-loan route configuration, receiver address, pool addresses, gas assumptions, slippage policy, and simulation outcomes. Update MEMORY.md with blockers and required human decisions. Do not submit transactions.
